snippet.title: Mewseum Masterpieces Trailer
snippet.description:
Mewseum: Masterpieces is available now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3417690/Mewseum_Masterpieces/

Mewseum: Masterpieces is a shikaku-style puzzle game where each solved grid reveals part of a great masterpiece. Solve hundreds of puzzles and discover unique paintings in the latest art exhibition of the feline world!

#puzzle #indiegame #indiedev #steam #shikaku #painting #cats
